result:
Round 97 passes. All 15 rows that can run here passed in a real browser, and I found no bugs. In Chromium at both 1280×720 and 1440×900, holding Enter after Cancel no longer closes the export dialog. The cancelled status stays on screen and focus stays on „დახურვა“.

- **The fix works:** in every held-Enter run, the recorder shows the first Enter (`repeat=false`) cancelling. The following repeats (`repeat=true`) land on „დახურვა“ and are blocked, with no click. That covers WAV at both sizes and MP3 at 1440. The same holds when the dialog is opened by holding Enter on the toolbar Export button (1280). No file was downloaded in the 10 s after any cancel.
- **Nothing broke:**
  - A fresh Enter, a mouse click and Space still close the dialog, and focus returns to the toolbar Export button.
  - Space still cancels.
  - Escape during a render does not cancel; after a cancel it closes the dialog.
  - A full WAV export after a cancel downloads one file that decodes: 24-bit, 48 kHz, stereo, 405.758 s, matching the status text.
- **Button classes:** the Cancel button has no `disabled` attribute and no `disabled:` class. The disabled „დახურვა“ button dims to 0.4 during a render and returns to 1 after a cancel. My first reading said 1 only because I measured while a 0.25 s fade was still running. The settled re-measure shows 0.4, so this is not a bug.
- **A's tests:** in my own scratch copy I got the same failing tests as A. On the original file, HE1, HE4, HE5 and HE7 fail. Mutations a, b and e turned the expected tests red, and the unmutated control passes 7/7. The 14 targeted test files (154 tests) pass. The new test file has no type assertions and checks exact strings.
- **Premium access is still protected:** without credentials, `/studio-lab` opens the demo, `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required" with no workspace, and `/api/studio-token` returns 401. The page made no forbidden requests and sent no `Authorization` headers.
- **Source unchanged:** the source tree is the same at the start and end of my check: HEAD `ce44036`, 2 modified and 2 new files, frozen list 526/526. The diff touches only the two allowed buttons and line 4 of doc 084. Doc 085 records everything the task asked for.

**Not verified:**
- The fake-Bearer token check is listed as blocked because the backend is not available in the cloud.
- The gate rows (full suite, typecheck, build, Biome, `npm run verify`, smoke e2e) are left to the gate.

Notes for B, none of them defects:
- Only Chromium was tested.
- In the browser, the MP3 cancel happened during the render phase, so the encoder-load case is covered only by the jsdom test HE7.
- The exported WAV has 576 samples at full scale. A similar count was already present in C round 90 (546 on the shorter project), so this round did not cause it.
